acceptance: A bounded Stripe Balance Transactions importer pages the provider's transaction history with a persisted cursor, three-day overlap, stable-id upserts and safe reruns; cursor never skips an incomplete page or failed import.

Source-backed, integer-cent transaction evidence is recorded with currency, dates, fee, net, reporting category, source and payout identity; wrong currency or unknown types never produce guessed journal entries.

The existing balanced source rules and K-2 poster book fees, Stripe service charges, disputes and payouts exactly once; Stripe charge, refund and payment rows do not duplicate their existing receipt/refund journals; replay/concurrency and absent opening evidence fail safely.

A cutoff-based clearing check compares the journal's clearing balance through the same yesterday-end Colorado timestamp with the verified owner's opening Stripe balance plus the net of imported transactions through that timestamp; an actual one-cent mismatch creates an owner-visible deduplicated exception; a later payment does not make yesterday look wrong. Missing/incomplete provider coverage is UNKNOWN, not a false match or mismatch.

The daily books-nightly automation runs after database backup, reconciles imported evidence, posts pending journals and checks clearing with bounded effort, checked CRON authentication, durable run results and safe retries; no customer messaging, transfers, refunds, live charges or payments are initiated.

Synthetic provider pages and disposable PostgreSQL tests prove pagination, overlap, provider faults, concurrent repeats, posting categories, unknowns, permission/credential failures, yesterday cutoff and one-cent detection. CI/build/security/browser and checked real-world acceptance remain independent.
